title: React Hooks Discipline
description: Hook anti-patterns that cause stale closures, infinite renders, and memory leaks.

rules.message: useEffect without dependency array runs on every render — usually a bug.
rules.remediation: Add explicit deps array. Empty [] for mount-only; otherwise list every external value used inside.

rules.message: If setState() is called during render (outside useEffect/event handler), it causes infinite loops.
rules.remediation: Wrap in useEffect or move to event handler. Render must be pure.

rules.message: useState with inline object literal recreates the initial value every render (cheap but wasteful).
rules.remediation: Wrap in lazy initializer: `useState(() => ({...}))` for non-trivial defaults.

rules.message: Effect creates a subscription/timer but may lack cleanup — memory leak risk on unmount/re-run.
rules.remediation: Return a cleanup function from the effect: `return () => clearInterval(...)`.
